sources.title: arXiv:2309.12312v2 [cs.RO] 24 Sep 2023
sources.snippet: Fig. 1. ForceSight is an RGBD-adapted, text-conditioned vision transformer. Given an RGBD image and a text prompt, ForceSight produces visual-force goals for a mobile manipulator. Action primitives, shown below each image, are appended to the text input by a simple low-level controller. D refers to the estimated depth of the goal location in meters.
